title: Figure 5.2: Top-view schematic of broad-coverage IEC luggage inspection system
description: Schematic captioned 'Figure 5.2. Schematic (view from top) of a broad coverage IEC inspection System for luggage inspection'. Three sources labeled 'D-D IEC for TNA' (with a Moderator), 'D-T IEC for PFNA/FNA' and 'IEC for x-ray' irradiate luggage on a curved conveyor, with dashed lines to a 'Detector Array'; the view is marked 'Top View'. Text below describes 14.1-MeV and 2.45-MeV neutron coverage and fuzzy-logic analysis of combined signals.
